sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:86

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 8:86:1
items.html: The three discernments occurred then of themselves, not through the act of the lower beings, Adam and Eve: Rather, they occurred through their upper one, which is ZON, as written above, that ZON sorted out from the MAN [Mayin Nukvin] of Vav and a point, and brought out upon them the three levels that are in these three discernments.
